skills.name: proactive_task
skills.description: Queue an explicitly authorized task for Jarvis to plan, route, delegate, monitor, and record proactively.

artifact_check.description: Optional predeclared exact file-byte check. Use a known expected hash, never an invented or worker-provided success claim.

path.description: Workspace-relative artifact path, no symlinks or traversal.

sha256.description: Known expected SHA-256 digest, 64 hex characters.

skills.name: proactive_status
skills.description: Report the global proactive state, pending events, and recent activity ledger.

skills.name: pause_jarvis
skills.description: Globally pause all new proactive Jarvis work while leaving current jobs visible.

skills.name: resume_jarvis
skills.description: Resume proactive Jarvis work and clear a previous stop-all latch.

skills.name: stop_all_jarvis_work
skills.description: Immediately stop every active Jarvis-managed agent and prevent new proactive work until resumed.
